owis.englishMeaning: maya is just like a mirage and like this is this `speech' of the `all'. How can that Reality be these clouds of imagination that appeared from nowhere?

owis.original: ग्रामो नास्ति कुतः सीमा । जन्मेंविण जीवात्मा । अद्वैतासी उपमा । द्वैताची ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेथें गांवच नाही तेथें त्या गावांची हद्द कशी सांगणार. जन्म झाला म्हणुन जीवात्मा आहे असे आपण म्हणतो पण जर जन्मच झाला नाहीं तर जीवात्मा आहे असे म्हणता येत नाही. जेथें गुणमय विश्वच मृगजळासारखें तेथें गुणांच्या पलीकडील निर्गुण ब्रह्म खरें मानता येत नाही. ब्रह्म सगुण नाही तसेंच तें निर्गुण नाही. द्वैताच्या अनुभवामध्यें ज्या कल्पना आपण वापरतो त्याच कल्पना आपण अद्वैत पतमवस्तु सांगण्यास वापरतो. पण त्यामुळें सद्वस्तु जशी आहे तशी ग्रहण होऊ शकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is no town how can there be its limits (if there is no sagun, how will there be talk of nirgun)? When there is no birth then, how can there be a jiva-atma? Similarly, how can comparisons born of duality be of any consequence in that non-dual and inexpressible brahman?

owis.original: मायेविरहित सत्ता । पदार्थेंविण जाणता । आविद्येंविण चैतन्यता । कोणास आली ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मायेच्या पसार्‍यांत सत्ता वावरते. पदार्थांत जाणतेपणा वावरतो. अविद्येंत चित्शक्तीचा खेळ चालतो.
owis.englishMeaning: How can there be this power if there is no maya? How can there be the one who knows it there is not this object of the `all'? And how could there be that which moves this `all' object without inertia (ie. ignorance) being first present?

owis.original: सत्ता चैतन्यता साक्षी । सर्व हि गुणाचपासीं । ठाईचें निर्गुण त्यासी । गुण कैचें ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सत्ता, साक्षित्व, व चैतन्य या कल्पना माया, दृश्य पदार्थ व अज्ञान यामुळें निर्माण होतात. पण ह्या तिन्ही गोष्टी गुणांच्या कक्षेंतील आहेत. ज्या स्वरुपाला (शुद्ध ब्रह्म) गुणांचा संपर्कच नाही तेथे हें सर्व लटकें पडतें.
owis.englishMeaning: So the power, chaitanya and this witness are in the possession of this sattwa guna of `I am' (ie. sagun). How then can that nirgun of this sagun be called that original nirgun?

owis.original: ऐसें जें गुणरहित । तेथें नामाचा संकेत । तोचि जाणावा अशाश्वत । निश्र्चयेंसी ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असें जें गुणरहित ब्रह्म तें निर्गुण या शब्दाच्या खुणेनें सांगावयाचे. पण तो शब्द व त्यानें दर्शविलेला संकेत दोन्ही निश्र्चयपूर्वक अशाश्वत आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: For such a nirgun is actually the assigning of no guna to this sagun and so it is still within this `speech'. Then that brahman should be known, as definitely non-eternal.

owis.original: निर्गुण ब्रह्मासि संकेतें । नामें ठेविलीं बहुतें । तें वाच्यब्रह्म त्यातें । नाश आहे ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गुणरहित ब्रह्माला खुणेनें ओळखण्यासाठीं पुष्कळ नावें देतात. म्हणून त्यांना वाच्यब्रह्म म्हणतात. परंतु तें सर्व नाशिवंत आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: It is in fact this `all' calling this `speech' as the nirgun brahman. Afterwards that Reality is this expressible brahman and it will also get destroyed.

owis.original: आनंदाचा अनुभव । हाहि वृत्तीचाचि भाव । तदाकारीं ठाव । वृत्तीस नाहीं ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुभवब्रह्म-- आनंदब्रह्म -- आनंद होतो हा वृत्तीचाच भाग आहे. व त्याचा अनुभव त्या वृत्तीतच येतो. त्यामुळें हे दोन्ही वृत्ती बरोबर नाश पावणारे. तदाकारब्रह्म-- ब्रह्माशी तदाकार झाल्यानंतर वृत्ती राहू शकत नाही. परंतु तदाकारब्रह्मांत अज्ञान शिल्लक असल्यानें तसें होत नाही. त्यामुळे ते शुद्ध ब्रह्म नाही .
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this experience of bliss/ananda, then also that is the understanding of this knowing vritti. But in the `Dweller in That', this vritti cannot be found.

owis.original: अनुर्वाच्य याकारणें । संकेत वृत्तीच्या गुणें । तया संकेतास उणें । निवृत्तीनें आणिलें ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुर्वाच्यब्रह्म-- ब्रह्मज्ञानास अनुर्वाच्य असें वृत्तीच्या अनुरोधानें म्हणतात. म्हणून हें नुसते सांकेतीक आहे. परंतु शुद्ध ब्रह्माशी तदाकार झाल्यावर वृत्ती उरतच नाही. म्हणून त्यास अनिर्वाच्य म्हणणे गौणच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That inexpressible brahman is attained by means of this knowing vritti and the making of this vritti is due to the sattwa guna (to know). But this making of a vritti is put to shame by that nivritti (without the vritti). (Therefore though this knowing vritti or sattwa guna is required to reach that pure inexpressible brahman, still it does not remain in the eternal)

owis.original: अनुर्वाच्य ते निवृत्ती । तेचि उन्मनीची स्थिती । निरोपाधी विश्रांती । योगियांची ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मन वृत्तीमय असते. त्याच्या बदल होऊन मग निवृत्ती येते. यालाच उन्मनी अवस्था म्हणतात. यामधें साधक बंधनमुक्त, मर्यादामुक्त असतो. यामुळें योगीजनांची हीच विश्रांतीची जागा असते.
owis.englishMeaning: That inexpressible brahman is nivritti and that is the state of unmana (ie. no-mind). That inexpressible has no limiting concept and that is the resting place of the yogi.

owis.original: वस्तु जे कां निरोपाधी । तेचि सहज समाधी । जेणें तुटे आदिव्याधी । भवदुखाची ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उपाधिशून्य सद्वस्तु स्वतः बनणें म्हणजेच सहजसमाधि. यामुळें संसारांतील आधी व्याधी नष्ट होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: How can mula maya be that Self without any limiting concept? That is sa- haja/Natural samadhi and `there' this mula maya, the original disease that has caused the sorrows of this worldly life, has been cut out.

owis.original: जो उपाधीचा अंत । तोचि जाणावा सिद्धांत । सिद्धांत आणी वेदांत । धादांत आत्मा ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व उपाधींचा नाश होणें हाच ब्रह्मसाक्षात्कार होय. वेदान्ताचा अखेरचा सिद्धांत हाच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush is the end of this limiting concept of mula maya and that should be known as the Truth/siddhant. It is the atma verified by vedanta, verified by guru and verified by one's Self-experience.

owis.original: असो ऐसें जें शाश्वत ब्रह्म । जेथें नाहीं मायाभ्रम । अनुभवी जाणे वर्म । स्वानुभवें ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. असें जें शाश्वत ब्रह्म आहे तेथें माया अगर मायेचा भ्रमसुद्धा नाही. अज्ञान, दृश्य, कल्पना कांहींच नाही. जें साधक शुद्ध ब्रह्माचा साक्षात अनुभव घेतात, त्यांना परब्रह्माचे आकलन होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When this mula maya is that eternal brahman then, there is no delusion of maya `here'. It is the essence hidden within this `I am' experience and it is known as Self- experience.

owis.original: आपुलेन अनुभवें । कल्पनेसि मोडावें । मग सुकाळीं पडावें । अनुभवाचे ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वस्वरुपाच्या अनुभवानें देहबुद्धी, मी देह ह्या कल्पना काढून टाकाव्यांत. तसें झालें म्हणजे सर्वत्र ब्रह्मस्वरुपाचा अनुभव येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: To experience our Self, every thought should be destroyed and then the happiness of this experience will come to an end (then this original thought or ananda/bliss of sat/existence will come to an end).

owis.original: निर्विकल्पास कल्पावें । कल्पना मोडें स्वभावें । मग नसोनि असावें । कल्पकोटी ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहबुद्धीची कल्पना नाहीशीं करण्यासाठीं निर्विकल्प ब्रह्मस्वरुपाची कल्पना करावी. यामुळें आपोआप " मी देह आहे " ही कल्पना नष्ट होते. नंतर मग निर्विकल्पता आल्यावर मी पणाने नसुन सद्धा ब्रह्मस्वरुपांत अनंत काळ राहावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore you should imagine that nirvikalpa (ie. thoughtless) and thought will then naturally be destroyed. Then though not being, you will be that pure knowledge.

owis.original: कल्पनेचें येक बरें । मोहरितांच मोहरे । स्वरुपीं घालिता भरे । निर्विकल्पीं ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पनेची एक विशेषता म्हणजे ज्याची कल्पना करावयाची त्याच्याशी तीं एकरुप होते. म्हणून ती स्वस्वरुपाकडे नेली तर ती निर्विकल्प होते.
owis.englishMeaning: If that One pure knowledge imagines then, it will blossom wherever it is planted (then that infinite potential will become whatever it is imagined to be). But if you place it in that swarup then, that nirvikalpa will be harvested.

owis.original: निर्विकल्पासी कल्पितां । कल्पनेची नुरे वार्ता । निःसंगास भेटों जातां । निःसंग होइजे ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण जें निर्विकल्प आहे, त्याची कल्पना करुं लागल्यावर कल्पनाच विलीन होते. कारण ब्रह्मस्वरुप निःसंग असल्यानें साधक स्वतःच निःसंग बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you imagine that which cannot be imagined then, the rumour of imagination gets dissolved. When the unattached is met, then there will be the unattached only.

owis.original: पदार्थाऐसें ब्रह्म नव्हे । मा तें हाती धरुन द्यावें । असो हें अनुभवाचें । सद्गुरुमुखें ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म म्हणजे दृश्य पदार्थ नाही, जें हातांत घेऊन देता येईल. सद्गुरुमुखानें तें श्रवण करुन मगआपण त्याचा अनुभव घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: brahman is not like this object of the `all' and therefore That should take possession of this `object' (all this should be merged in Him; for He is within and beyond anything that can be seen by the eyes or perceived by the mind). Then that thoughtless Self should experience everything through sadguru's form (He uses knowledge while rema- ining forever the One without a second; the Master of duality). (maharaj- the Master uses Knowledge....otherwise how could I speak)

owis.original: पुढें कथेचा अन्वये । केलाचि करुं निश्र्चये । जेणे अनुभवासी ये । केवळब्रह्म ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतांपर्यंत ब्रह्मस्वरुप कसें आहे, ते सांगितले. तें अधिक निश्र्चितपणें समजण्यासाठीं पुढें विवेचन केले आहे. तें श्रवण केल्यानें शुद्ध व शाश्वत ब्रह्माचा अनुभव येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: When one has faith in this `I am' then, one's conviction will grow stronger and stronger. Due to this conviction, there will come to this `I am' experience, that pure knowledge of brahman. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Vimal Brahma Nirupan (A Discourse on Pure/Stainless Brahman)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ब्रह्म नभाहून निर्मळ । पाहातां तैसेंचि पोकळ । अरुप आणी विशाळ । मर्यादेवेगळें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म आकाशाहून मलरहित आहे. पाहायाला गेलो तर तें आकाशासारखें पोकळ, कोणतेंही रुप नसलेले आणि मर्यादा नसलेले असे विशाळ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That brahman is more pure than the sky. When you understand it then it appears empty and it is said to be formless and huge beyond any limits (ie. endless).

owis.original: येकविस स्वर्गे सप्त पाताळ । मिळोन एक ब्रह्मगोळ । ऐसीं अनंत तें निर्मळ । व्यापून असे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकवीस स्वर्ग व सात पाताळ मिळून एक ब्रह्मगोल होतो. अशा अनेक ब्रह्मगोलांना या निर्मळ ब्रह्मानें व्यापून टाकले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That One is mixed in the twenty-one heavens (ie. dream) and seven lower hells (ie. deep sleep) and the created universe/brahmanda. In this way, that pure Reality is endless and pervades like the sky (when there are the three worlds of waking, dream and sleep then, brahman remains hidden within them and He is said to be pervasive and endless. But, in truth, that pure brahman is beyond the beyond, for there is nothing but Him and therefore nothing for Him to pervade).

owis.original: अनंत ब्रह्मांडांखालतें । अनंत ब्रह्मांडांवरुतें । तेणेंविण स्थळ रितें । अणुमात्र नाहीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनंत ब्रह्मांडांच्या वर आणी अनंत ब्रह्मांडांच्या खालीं जिकडे तिकडे ब्रह्म पसरले आहे. जेथें ब्रह्म नाही अशी कोठेही रीकामी जागा नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: That endless brahman is below the *brahmanda and that endless brahman is above the brahmanda. There is no space, even as small as an atom, without that brahman. *(Universal body ie. whatever can be seen or perceived, of which the individual body/pinda is a part)

owis.original: जळीं स्थळीं काष्ठीं पाषाणीं । ऐसी वदे लोकवाणी । तेणेंविण रिता प्राणी । येकहि नाहीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोक म्हणतात कीं, जळीं, स्थळीं, काष्ठीं व पाषाणी ब्रह्म व्यापून आहे. ब्रह्म नाहीं असा एकही प्राणी नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: That brahman is within the water, within the land, within the wood and within the stone. But when that gets publicly declared by the voices of this world then, only the water, the land, the wood and the stone are seen (when the people of the world say, "I am so and so" then, they say, "This is water and that is a stone" etc. and the brahman is as if not there). Then without that brahman there is only the emptiness within the prana (and there is waking and dreaming and sleeping and nothing is real nor eternal).

owis.original: जळचरांस जैसें जळ । बाह्याभ्यांतरीं निखळ । तैसें ब्रह्म हें केवळ । जीवमात्रांसी ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समुद्रामधें जळचरांना पाणी जसें आंत बाहेर व्यापून असते, त्याचप्रमाणें सर्व जीवांना ब्रह्म हें आंतबाहेर व्यापून आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as water is completely outside and inside for the creatures of the water, so too, outside and inside of every jiva there is that thoughtless pure brahman.

owis.original: जळावेगळा ठाव आहे । ब्रह्माबाहेरी जातां नये । म्हणौनि उपमा न साहे । जळाची तया ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाण्याची उपमा ब्रह्माला देता येत नाही कारण पाण्याला मर्यादा आहे. ते संपले की जमीन असते. पण ब्रह्माचे तसे नाही. ब्रह्म कोठेंच संपत नाही. ब्रह्माला ओलांडून पलीकडे जाता येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: But the comparison with water is not appropriate for that brahman because there are dry places beyond water, but outside of brahman one cannot go.

owis.original: आकाशाबाहेरी पळों जातां । पुढें आकाशचि तत्वता । तैसें तयां अनंता । अंतचि नाहीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशाच्या पलीकडे जावें असे कोणाला वाटलें व तो पळत निघाला तरी तो जिकडे जाईल तिकडे त्याच्यापुढें त्याला आकाश दिसते. त्याचप्रमाणें अनंत ब्रह्माला कोठे अंतच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if one tries to run outside of space still, ahead there is truly only space. That brahman is like that, for it has no end

owis.original: परी जें अखंड भेटलें । सर्वांगास लिगटलें । अति निकट परी चोरलें । सकळांसि जें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्मापासूनच तें आपल्या अंगाला चिकटलेले आहे. इतकें जवळ असूनही तें सर्वांच्यापासून लपून राहीलेले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that unbroken brahman meets with this mula maya then, it gets attached to this `I am' body. And though it is so extremely close, still it has been covered over by this `all' of mula maya.

owis.original: तयामधेंचि असिजे । परी तयास नेणिजे । उमजे भास नुमजे । परब्रह्म तें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण सर्व त्या ब्रह्मांतच असतो. पण त्यामधें आहोत याची जाणीव आपल्याला नसते. भ्रमानें निर्माण होणारा भास समजतो पण ज्याच्यामुळें हा भास निर्माण होतो ते ब्रह्म समजत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: This mula maya is within that Reality but it does not know that Reality. Appearance is born out of that parabrahman but that parabrahman does not know this appearance.

owis.original: आकाशामधें आभाळ । तेणें आकाश वाटे डहुळ । परी तें मिथ्या निवळ । आकाशचि असे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशांत ढग येतात त्यामुळें तें मलिन झाल्यासारखे वाटते. पण ढगांमुळें आलेला मलिनपणा आकाशाला चिकटत नाही. ढग गेल्यावर आकाश परत जसें तसेंच असते व दिसते. तसाच संबंध ब्रह्म व विश्र्व यामधें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If clouds appear in the space then, it is felt that the space is disturbed but this is just an illusion, for the space is ever pure and remains untouched.

owis.original: नेहार देतां आकाशीं । चक्रें दिसती डोळ्यांसी । तैसे दृश्य ज्ञानियांसी । मिथ्यारुप ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशाकडे सारखें टक लावून पाहिलें तर डोळ्यापुढें प्रकाशाची चक्रें दिसतात. तीं कांहीं खरी नसतात. त्याचप्रमाणें अज्ञानी माणसांच्या अनुभवाला येणारे दृश्यविश्र्व ज्ञानी पुरुषांना त्यांच्या अनुभवानें खोटेपणाने प्रतीत होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When we focus intently upon the space, then swirls are seen before our eyes (ie. then in the space or nothing, something appears). Alternatively, when the gnyani carefully examines this visible `all' with vivek, then he comes to realize that it is an illusory form caused by the act of focusing. (siddharameshwar maharaj- when you look up at the moon you do not see that which is between the moon and the eye. Only when you try to see that which is between the moon and the eye, does space appear. You were there as that imperceptible brahman but when That tries to see its Self then you feel, `I am there')

owis.original: मिथ्याचि परी आभासे । निद्रिस्तांस स्वप्न जैसें । जाग जालियां अपैसें । बुझों लागे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्य खोटें म्हटलें तरी इंद्रियांना ते दिसते. पण माणसाला झोपेंत स्वप्न पडते. झोपेंत त्या स्वप्नांतील सर्व त्याला खरेच वाटते. पन जागें झाल्यावर स्वप्न व ती दृश्यें खरी नाहीत, नव्हती हें त्याला समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: And though the gnyani knows it is illusory, still it appears. It is like the dream of a sleeping man who has awoken. He automatically understands that it was never true.

owis.original: तैसें आपुलेन अनुभवें । ज्ञानें जागृतीसि यावें । मग माईक स्वभावें । कळों लागे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ह्याचप्रमाणें जो स्वस्वरुपाचा अनुभव घेतो त्यास आत्मज्ञान होते. त्या ज्ञानाने त्याची अज्ञानरुपी नीद्रा जाते. मग त्याला दृश्य विश्र्व खरें नसून माईक आहे. हे कळूं लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: In the same, when you experience an awakening through knowledge then, automa- tically the illusory is understood.

owis.original: आतां असो हें कुवाडें । जे ब्रह्मांडापैलिकडे । तेंचि आतां निवाडें । उमजोन दाऊं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां ही गहन व दुर्बोध भाषा पुरे. ब्रह्मांडाला व्यापून उरणारे जें परब्रह्म तें उमजेल असें सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When now, the `babbling abroad' of the great elements (ie. each element brought more and more objectivity until the gross world appeared) has become this mula maya beyond the created universe/brahmanda then, that Reality can be selected out and understood (first understand mula maya and then understand brahman).

owis.original: ब्रह्म ब्रह्मांडीं कालवलें । पदार्थासी व्यापून ठेलें । सर्वांमधें विस्तारलें । अंशमात्रें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म ब्रह्मांडांमधे कालवलेले आहे. सर्व पदार्थांस व्यापून आहे. सर्वांत पसरलेले असले तरी तो पसारा अंशमात्रेंच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: brahman is mixed within this whole universe and He is pervading this object of the `all' also. And due to a mere fraction of Him there has come within this `all', the expansion we call the gross world.

owis.original: ब्रह्मामधें सृष्टी भासे । सृष्टीमधें ब्रह्म असे । अनुभव घेतां आभासे । अंशमात्रें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या ब्रह्मांत सर्व विश्र्व मावते. तसेंच सर्व विश्र्वांतही ते व्यापून आहे. मात्र त्याचा अनुभव घ्यावा तर तें अंशमात्रेच आहे. असा अनुभव येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In brahman, the gross creation has appeared and in the gross creation, brahman is. This `I am' experience that you get is but a semblance of Him and even this is only a fraction of Him.

owis.original: अंशमात्रे सृष्टीभीतरीं । बाहेरी मर्यादा कोण करी । सगळें ब्रह्म ब्रह्मांडोदरी । माईल कैसें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या अवाढव्य विश्र्वामधें ब्रह्म जर अल्प अंशमात्रेच आहे. तर विश्र्वाच्याबाहेर तें किती आहे ह्याचे मोजमाप कोण करेल? तें अपरंपार, अनंत ब्रह्म एवढ्याशा विश्वांच्या पोटांत मावेलच कसें.
owis.englishMeaning: Though only a mere fraction of that brahman is within this gross creation still, outside of this creation, who could limit Him? Really how could the whole of brahman ever be confined within this universe?

owis.original: अमृतीमधें आकाश । सगळें सांठवतां प्रयास । म्हणौन तयाचा अंश । बोलिजेतो ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचें तीर्थ ठेवण्याच्या छोट्या चंबूमध्यें सगळें आकाश साठवण्याचा प्रयत्न वाया जातो. तसें करतां येत नाही. त्याचप्रमाणें विश्र्वामधें संपूर्ण ब्रह्म सामावून घेण्याचा प्रयत्न व्यर्थ जातो. म्हणून विश्र्वामध्यें ब्रह्माचा अंश व्यापून आहे असे म्हणालो.
owis.englishMeaning: It is like trying to put the whole of space in a pot (ie. our small individual mind). Therefore this small part of that brahman should be made into this `all' (when nothing is there then, only space is there ie. `all'. This `all' or knowledge is not brahman but at least it is a semblance of that brahman and now that brahman can be understood).

owis.original: ब्रह्म तैसें कालवलें । परी तें नाहीं हालवलें । सर्वांमधें परी संचले । संचलेपणें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व पदार्थांत ब्रह्म मिसळले आहे. तें अखंड स्थिर आहे. तें कधीं हललेच नाही. तें इतके घट्टपणें सांचलेले आहे की त्यास हलणें शक्य नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: That brahman is mixed within this `all' but it is not disturbed like this `all'. He is within this `all' and due to this collecting together of everything into this `all' (ie. un- derstanding nothing or no things are true), the brahman appears to have been collected together (this understanding of `I am' is mistaken as that Reality).

owis.original: पंचभूतीं असे मिश्रित । परंतु तें पंचभूतातीत । पंकीं आकाश अलिप्त । असोनि जैसें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचभूतामध्यें तें मिसळले आहे. पण त्यांना चिकटलेलें नाही. जसेंकी चिखलामध्यें आकाश दिसते पण आकाशाला चिखल चिकटत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: He is mixed within the five great elements but He is beyond the five elements. He is just like the space in the mud and He remains untouched.

owis.original: ब्रह्मास दृष्टांत न घडे । बुझावया देणें घडे । परी दृष्टांतीं साहित्य पडे । विचारितां आकाश ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म कसे आहे हे सांगण्यास कोणताही दृष्तांत योग्य वाटत नाही. परंतु तें कसें आहे याची थोडी कल्पना येण्यासाठीं दृश्य विश्र्वांतील दृष्टांत द्यावा लागतो. त्यासाठीं वाङ्मयाची मदत घ्यावी लागते. त्या दृष्टीनें विचार करता आकाशाचा दृष्टांत देऊन ब्रह्मस्वरुप सांगण्याचा प्रयत्न करावा लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Though a simile cannot accomplish that brahman, still it can bring that under- standing, for within this simile of space/akash (ie. zero/nothing) one can come upon thoughtlessness (ie. brahman) (maharaj- nothing was in the room, he said, but the bloody fool forgot he was there)

owis.original: खंब्रह्म ऐसी श्रुती । गगनसदृशं हे स्मृती । म्हणौनि ब्रह्मास दृष्टांतीं । आकाश घडे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खंब्रह्म म्हणजे आकाश हे ब्रह्म असें श्रुति सांगते. श्रुतिनें तसे सांगितल्यानें ब्रह्माला आकाशाचा दृष्टांत देतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The shruti says, `The sky is brahman' and the smriti says, `That thoughtless Self is like the sky'. Therefore, space/akash has been given as a simile for that brahman (see V.1).

owis.original: काळिमा नस्तां पितळ । मग तें सोनेंचि केवळ । सुन्यत्व नस्तां निवळ । आकाश ब्रह्म ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पितळाच्या पिवळेपणांत किंचीत काळसरपणा नसतां तर तें पितळ नसून सोनेंच आहे असे म्हटले असते. तसेंच आकाश हें ब्रह्मासारखेंच सूक्ष्म व विशाळ आहे. पण आकाशांत शून्यत्व असतें तेंच ब्रह्मामध्यें नसते. नाहींतर आकाश ब्रह्मस्वरुपच झालें असते.
owis.englishMeaning: If brass did not have any stains then, it could be compared to pure gold. And similarly, when there is not the `nothingness' of space then, there is that pure brahman.

owis.original: म्हणौनि ब्रह्म जैसें गगन । आणि माया जैसा पवन । आडळे परी दर्शन । नव्हे त्याचें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म आकाशासारखें आहे व माया वायुसारखी आहे असे म्हणतात. वायु आहे पण तो प्रत्यक्ष दिसत नाही. त्याचप्रमाणे मायेचा प्रभाव दिसतो पण माया दिसत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Now if brahman is likened to the sky then, maya can be likened to the wind. And maya like the wind, can be felt but this is not that `vision' of brahman.

owis.original: शब्दसृष्टीची रचना । होत जात क्षणक्षणा । परंतु ते स्थिरावेना । वायुच ऐसी ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्दसृष्टींत सारखी रचना बदलत असते. कारण लोक सारखें शब्द बोलत असतात. पण ही शब्दसृष्टी अशाश्वत असते. वायुला जशी स्थिरता नसते तशीच शब्दसृष्टीला पण स्थिरता नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this world constructed of words (see V. 4, "This is water, stone" etc.), then a world gets created and destroyed every *moment. And when that Reality cannot be made still then, it appears just like the wind (even if the thoughts of a world are left still, that original thought of maya remains). *(maharaj- one word has to be forgotten before the other word can br heard)

owis.original: असो ऐसी माया माईक । शाश्वत तें ब्रह्म येक । पाहों जातां अनेक । व्यापून आहे ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मायासुद्धा अशीच अस्थिर व अशाश्वत असते. फक्त ब्रह्म तेवढें शाश्वत आहे. एकच ब्रह्म अनेकांना व्यापून आहे असे सूक्ष्म दृष्टीनें पाहातां आढळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: So like this is this illusory maya and that One eternal brahman. And if one tries to understand Him, then He becomes the pervader of the numerous different forms (ie. then you remain and He is felt to be just like the space).

owis.original: पृथ्वीसी भेदून आहे । परी तें ब्रह्म कठीण नव्हे । दुजी उपमा न साहे । तया मृदत्वासी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जड पृथ्वीला भेदून तिच्यात राहणारे ब्रह्म पृथ्वीसारखें जड नाही. किंबहुना तें इतकें सूक्ष्म आहे कीं त्याच्या इतकें सूक्ष्म अजुन कांहींच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Then He permeates the earth element/prithvi but, that brahman is not hard, for there is nothing that can equal the softness of Him.

owis.original: पृथ्वीहूनि मृद जळ । जळाहूनि तो अनळ । अनळाहूनि कोमळ । वायो जाणावा ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीपेक्षां सूक्ष्म पाणी असते. पाण्यापेक्षां तेज सूक्ष्म असते. तेजाापेक्षां वायु सूक्ष्म असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Water is softer than earth and fire is softer than water and you should know that the wind is softer than fire.

owis.original: वायोहूनि तें गगन । अत्यंतचि मृद जाण । गगनाहून मृद पूर्ण । ब्रह्म जाणावें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायुपेक्षा आकाश अत्यंत सूक्ष्म असते. आणि आकाशाहून ब्रह्म सूक्ष्म असते. या सूक्ष्म ब्रह्मास पाहण्यास जीवही अती सूक्ष्म व्हावा लागतो. त्यावेळीं त्याला ब्रह्मस्वरुपाचा अनुभव होण्याची पात्रता येते.
owis.englishMeaning: Now know that this sky is much more delicate than the wind and then known that that full and complete brahman is softer than the sky even.

owis.original: वज्रास असे भेदिलें । परी मृदत्व नाहीं गेलें । उपमेरहित संचलें । कठिण ना मृद ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वज्र अति कठीण पण त्यासही ब्रह्म भेदून जाते. तरीही ब्रह्माचे सूक्ष्मपण कमी होत नाही. खरें म्हणजे ब्रह्माला उपमा देता येत नाही. तें जड किंवा सूक्ष्म नसून सर्व ठिकाणीं भरलेले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That penetrates even steel but it does not lose its softness. That is incomparable, for It is neither hard nor soft.

owis.original: पृथ्वीमधें व्यापून असे । पृथ्वी नासे तें न नासे । जळ शोषे तें न शोषे । जळीं असोनी ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म पृथ्वीला आंतून बाहेरुन व्यापून आहे. परंतु पृथ्वीचा नाश झाला तरी त्याला नाश नाही. ब्रह्म पाण्याला व्यापून आहे. पण पाणी शोषलें जाते, नाश पावते. पण ब्रह्म शोषलेही जात नाही व त्याचा नाशपण होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: It pervades within the elemental earth but still It is not destroyed when the earth is destroyed. And being in the elemental water still It is not dried up when the water dries up.

owis.original: तेजीं असे परी जळेना । पवनीं असे परी चळेना । गगनीं असे परी कळेना । परब्रह्म तें ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म तेजाला व्यापून असते. पण तेजानें तें जळत नाही. ब्रह्म वायूला व्यापून असते. पण वायूसारखें तें चळत नाही. ब्रह्म आकाश व्यापून असते पण तें आपल्याला कळत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: It is in the fire but It is not burnt. It is in wind but It does not move. It is in the sky but It cannot be understood and that is parabrahman.

owis.original: शेरीर अवघें व्यापलें । परी तें नाहीं आडळलें । जवळिच दुरावलें । नवल कैसें ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या सर्व शरीरभर ब्रह्म त्याला व्यापून आहे. परंतु तें आपल्याला आढळत नाही. तें इतकें जवळ असून फार दूर झाले हें नवलच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But when there is this `all' body pervading everything then, that brahman cannot be met. How can this marvel be so near and yet be so far away?

owis.original: सन्मुखचि चहुंकडे । तयामधें पाहाणें घडे । बाह्याभ्यांतरीं रोकडें । सिद्धचि आहे ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळीकडे चारी दिशांना ब्रह्म समोरच असते. आपले पाहाणे व इतर सर्व गोष्टी ब्रह्मांतच घडतात. आंतून व बाहेरुन व्यापून असलेले ब्रह्म स्वयंसिद्ध आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When it is in front of us and in all four directions around us then, within that Reality, It is being understood as space. But inside and outside of this `I am' experience, there is that siddha/perfect One.

owis.original: तयामधेंचि आपण । आपण सबाह्य तें जाण । दृशावेगळी खूण । गगनासारिखी ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण ब्रह्मामधेंच जगतों व राहातों. आपल्या आंत बाहेर तेंच आहे. अवकाशांतील सर्व दृश्य विलीन केल्यावर जें केवळ निव्वळ आकाश उरतें तसें ब्रह्म आहे. हे खूणेनेच समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: You are within that Reality. Know that That is inside and outside of you. And though that thoughtless Reality is separate from this visible `all' still, It is said to be like the sky (ie. the state of witnessing or zero).

owis.original: कांहीं नाहींसें वाटलें । तेथेंचि तें कोंदाटलें । जैसें न दिसे आपलें । आपणासि धन ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इथें कांहीं नाही असे जेथें वाटते तेथेंच ब्रह्म पुष्कळ भरलेले असते. आपण स्वतः बाजूला ठेवलेले धन आपल्याला दिसत नाही. तसेंच ब्रह्माच्या बाबतींत घडून येते.
owis.englishMeaning: And when this thing called the `all' is not felt then, that brahman `there' fills everywhere. He is like your own treasure but you cannot see Him.

owis.original: जो जो पदार्थ दृष्टी पडे । तें त्या पदार्था ऐलिकडे । अनुभवें हें कुवाडें । उकलावें ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जी जी गोष्ट आपण पाहातों ती दृष्टीस पडण्या आधी मध्यें ब्रह्म असते. स्थूल दृष्टीस ब्रह्म न दिसणारे असल्यानें स्वरुपानुभावेंच तें कोडे उलगडून घ्यावें
owis.englishMeaning: *When the purush's vision falls on this visible `all' object then, know that it is that Reality `there' that has become this object `here' on this side (ie. that Reality perceives its own Self as its reflection). Still by means of this `I am' experience, that thoughtless brahman should be disentangled from the `babbling abroad' of the elements (ie. the becoming objective and creating a gross body and world of `many' names and forms). *(When you try to see that which is between the moon and the eye ie. brahman then, you are looking at your Self and you imagine space)

owis.original: मागें पुढें आकाश । पदार्थेंविण जो पैस । पृथ्वीविण भकास । येकरुप ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व पदार्थांना आकाश मागेंपुढें व्यापून असते. सर्व पदार्थ समजा नाहींसे झालें तरी अवका उरेल. त्यांतच पृथ्वीही नाहीशी झाली तर सगळीकडे ओसाड पोकळी दिसेल.
owis.englishMeaning: When this space is behind as well as in front then, there is that purush without the expansive space of this `all' object (ie. when you feel that there is only this space in front of you then, the brahman it seeing His own refection and you feel there is this `I am' of space. But when this space is behind, in front, as well as in every direction then, this space cannot remain as space anymore and there is the understanding of that One thoughtless purush). Then there is not the empty gross creation of `many' forms and there is this One form/rup (ie. swarup).

owis.original: जें जें रुप आणी नाम । तो तो नाथिलाच भ्रम । नामरुपातीत वर्म । अनुभवी जाणे ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इंद्रियांना दिसणारा नामरुपांचा आकार मुळांतच नसणारा भ्रम आहे. नामरुपांच्या पलीकडे असलेले ब्रह्मरुप रहस्य साक्षात्कारीच जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But when there is this mula maya of `name'/existence and `form'/knowledge then, that purush has become this non-existent delusion. Still, that essence beyond this `name' and `form' can only be known by the `experienced' (only one who has understood this `I am' experience can go beyond this experience of `name'/beingness and `form'/knowing- ness and be that thoughtless, formless purush or brahman).

owis.original: नभीं धूम्राचे डोंगर । उचलती थोर थोर । तैसें दावी वोडंबर । माया देवी ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशामध्यें मोठमोठे धुराचे डोंगर दिसतात. पण तें सगळें तात्पुरतें असतात. आकाशाला त्यांचा स्पर्श होत नाही. त्याचप्रमाणें शुद्ध ब्रह्मांमधें मायेने विश्र्वाचे अवडंबर आढळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That great brahman within the sky has assumed a form and then that is said to be like a mountain of smoke (ie. our imagination/words plays and then many forms get created out of the cloud in the sky). In this way, the goddess maya displays her magic (everywhere He is there and though He is everything, something else appears ie. the `all' of maya appears just like the cloud appears in the sky. And then our thoughts and imagination create something else upon this cloud and we say, "It is like a mountain of smoke" etc. First we imagine the `all' and upon that we then imagine the `many' forms).

owis.original: ऐसी माय अशाश्वत । ब्रह्म जाणावें शाश्वत । सर्वां ठाईं सदोदित । भरलें असे ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें माया अशाश्वत असून ब्रह्म मात्र शाश्वत आहे. ते सर्वत्र सर्व ठिकांणी कायम भरलेलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is the non-eternal maya; therefore that eternal brahman should be known. Truly, this place of the `all' is completely full of that ever-arisen brahman.

owis.original: पोथी वाचूं जातां पाहे । मातृकांमधेंचि आहे । नेत्रीं निघोनि राहे । मृदपणें ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ग्रंथ, पोथी वाचीत असतां ब्रह्मच वाचत असतें. अक्षरांतील कानामात्रांमधें तेंच असते. सूक्ष्मपणें डोळ्यांत राहून पाहण्याची क्रिया तेंच करतें.
owis.englishMeaning: He is seeing when you read this spiritual text; He only is within the letters and He stays within and goes out through your eyes.

owis.original: श्रवणें शब्द ऐकतां । मनें विचार पाहातां । मना सबाह्य तत्वता । परब्रह्म तें ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कानानें शब्द ऐकतां, मनानें विचार करीत असतां, मनाच्या आंतबाहेर खरोखर ब्रह्मच असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: And He hears this `word' (ie. `I am') by means of shravan and He understands thoughtlessness by means of this mind. Truly inside and outside of this mind there is only that parabrahman.

owis.original: चरणें चालतां मार्गीं । जें आडळे सर्वांगीं । करें घेतां वस्तुलागीं । आडवें ब्रह्म ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पायांनी वाट चालत असतां ब्रह्म सर्व शरीरांत व्यापून असते. हातांनीं वस्तु घेत असतां त्या वस्तुला व्यापून ब्रह्मच येतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Whether you are walking with your feet (ie. "I am a body") or you are moving along this path of understanding still, He is forever being met within this `all' body (He is always there and everything is truly taking place in this `all' of knowledge; however these things cannot be understood as long as you remain with the conviction, "I am a body"). But when you take that pure Self as a possession in your hand (ie. when you objectify) then, that One brahman is being obstructed.5

owis.original: असो इंद्रियेंसमुदाव । तयामधें वर्ते सर्व । जाणों जातां मोडे हांव । इंद्रियांची ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या सर्व इंद्रियांना आंतबाहेर ब्रह्मच व्यापून आहे. त्यामध्यें इंद्रियांची सर्व कामें होत असतात. परंतु इंद्रियांनी ते जाणण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तर त्यांचा हव्यास मोडून जातो. ब्रह्म अतिद्रिय असल्यानें इंद्रियांची गति खुंटते.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is this meeting place (ie. `all') of the *senses. This `all' place exists and functions within that pure brahman and if you try to know Him then, the desire to `see' through your senses gets broken and this `all' remains (then you see with the `eyes' of knowledge and not with your senses). *(maharaj- you should listen with all your senses)

owis.original: तें जवळिच असे । पाहों जातां न दिसे । न दिसोन वसे । कांहीं येक ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म आपल्या अगदीं जवळच आहे. परंतु तें पहावें म्हटलें तर दिसत नाही. तरी न दिसतासुद्धा त्याच्या असण्यांत फरक पडत नाही. तें असतेंच
owis.englishMeaning: And though that brahman is so very near, if you try to see Him then, He will not be seen and this `all' will be seen. But by not trying to see Him, this `all' will stay as that One.6

owis.original: जें अनुभवेंचि जाणावें । सृष्टीचेनि अभावें । आपुलेन स्वानुभवें । पाविजे ब्रह्म ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम हें सारें दृश्य विश्र्व मनांतून नाहीसें झालें पाहिजे. आपल्या देहासकट सर्व दृश्य सृष्टी सत्य नाहीं अशी खात्री झाली म्हणजे ब्रह्माचा अनुभव येण्याची पात्रता अंगीं येते. त्यानंतर ब्रह्माचा साक्षात्कार होतो व जीव ब्रह्मरुप होऊन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: Through this `experience' one should know the non-existence of the gross creation. And then by your Self-experience that brahman should be attained.

owis.original: ज्ञानदृष्टीचें देखणें । चर्मदृष्टी पाहो नेणे । अंतरवृत्तीचिये खुणे । अंतरवृत्ती साक्ष ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञानदृष्टीनेंच ब्रह्म जाणता येते. त्याला जाणण्यासाठीं आपली स्थूल दृष्टी उपयोगी पडत नाही. अंतरंगांत वृत्ती अत्यंत सूक्ष्म बनणें ही ज्ञानदृष्टीची खूण आहे. आणि हे ज्याचे त्यालाच अंतरंगांत समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: This `vision of knowledge' is your hidden treasure but it is not something that can see through your eyes. It is the inner knowing vritti and the witness and due to this, that pure knowledge can be gained.

owis.original: जाणे ब्रह्म जाणे माया । जाणे अनुभवाच्या ठाया । ते येक जाणावी तुर्या । सर्वसाक्षिणी ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जागृती, स्वप्न व सुषुप्ति या तीन अज्ञानवृत्तीच्या अवस्था आहेत. चवथी अवस्था तुर्या ही ज्ञानवृत्तीची अवस्था आहे. तुर्या अवस्थेंमध्यें एकीकडे ब्रह्माचे भान असते तर दुसरीकडे दृश्य विश्र्वाचे देखील भान असते. स्वानुभव येण्यासाठीं वृत्ति कोठें ठेववी हें तुर्येमधें बरोबर समजते. ती सर्वसाक्षीणी अवस्था आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: To know brahman means, to know maya and it is to know this place of the `expe- rience'. Then the One Reality should be known as the turya state and the witness of this `all'.

owis.original: साक्षत्व वृत्तीचें कारण । उन्मनी ते निवृत्ति जाण । जेथें विरे जाणपण । विज्ञान तें ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी आत्मा सर्व दृश्याच्या अतीत आहें, मी केवळ त्याचा साक्षी आहे अशी अवस्था असली तरी तिच्यामध्यें साक्षित्वाची सूक्ष्म वृत्ती असते. साक्षित्व मावळून ती वृत्तीसुद्धां विलीन झाली म्हणजे उन्मनी अवस्था प्राप्त होते. संपूर्ण वृत्तीरहित अवस्था म्हणजे उन्मनी होय. त्या निवृत्ती अवस्थेंमध्यें सर्व जाणतेपण विरते. तेंच विज्ञान होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The cause of this knowing vritti is witnessing and witnessing takes place within unmana (ie. no mind) and that should be called as nivritti (without vritti). It is when knowingness `here' dissolves and it is also called vignyan (dissolution of knowledge). (unmana, nivritti and vignyan are all the One pure brahman)

owis.original: जेथें अज्ञान सरे । ज्ञान तेंहि नुरे । विज्ञानवृत्ती मुरे । परब्रह्मीं ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम अज्ञान नाहींसे होऊन ज्ञान उदय पावतें. पुढें ज्ञान नाहींसे होऊन विज्ञान येते. अखेर विज्ञान देखील परब्रह्मामतजिरतें. मग केवळ शुद्ध व विमळ ब्रह्म तेवढें शिल्लक उरते.
owis.englishMeaning: When `here' the ignorance ceases and knowledge also disappears then, this knowing vritti of vignyan is absorbed in that parabrahman.

owis.original: ऐसें ब्रह्म शाश्वत । जेथें कल्पनेसी अंत । योगी जना येकांत । अनुभवें जाणावा ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असें हें शाश्वत ब्रह्म आहे. तेथें सर्व कल्पना नाहींशा होतात. योगी लोकांचा हा एकान्त आहे. तो अनुभवानें आपण समजून घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: been to that place because there is no knowing nor not knowing of brahman. There is you and only you. 52. When all thoughts `here' end then, there is that eternal brahman. Therefore through this experience of `I am' the mind should become that `aloneness' of the yogi. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Dwaita Kalpana Nirasan (The Refutation of the Concept of Duality)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: केवळ ब्रह्म जें बोलिलें । तें अनुभवास आलें । आणी मायेचेंहि लागलें । अनुसंधान ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोता म्हणाला कीं, मागे जे शुद्ध ब्रह्मस्वरुप सांगितलें, तें पूर्ण पटलें पण मायेचे जें अनुसंधान लागलें आहे तें कांहीं सुटत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When that single and alone brahman is this `speech' of mula maya then, that Reality has become this `I am' experience and this is the attention of maya.

owis.original: ब्रह्म अंतरी प्रकाशे । आणी मायाहि प्रत्यक्ष दिसे । आतां हे द्वैत निरसे । कवनेपरी हो ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म हें अंतरंगांत प्रगटते व माया बाहेर इंद्रियांना प्रत्यक्ष दिसते. हे द्वैत कसें नाहींसे होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Then brahman is shining from within this inner space (ie. He remains hidden and illuminates maya) and then maya sees through the senses (there was first the original illusion `I am' and then you say, "I am a body"). Now, how can that thoughtless Self cast off this duality?

owis.original: तरी आतां सावधान । येकाग्र करुनियां मन । माया ब्रह्म हें कवण । जाणताहे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें ऐकून वक्ता म्हणाला कीं, आतां सावध होऊन व मन ऐकाग्र करुन असा विचार करावा कीं, माया आणी ब्रह्म यांना कोण जाणते?
owis.englishMeaning: Be alert and make the mind one-pointed in this `now'. But even then there is *maya and brahman, therefore how is that thoughtless Self to be known? *(The purush that stays hidden within His prakruti and illuminates her has to drop this maya or `I am' if He wants to know Himself)

owis.original: सत्य ब्रह्नाचा संकल्प । मिथ्या मायेचा विकल्प । ऐसिया द्वैताचा जल्प । मनचि करी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनच संकल्प व विकल्प करतें. जेव्हां मनांत ब्रह्माची कल्पना येते तेव्हां ती खरी असते व तिला संकल्प म्हणतात. जेव्हां मन मायेची कल्पना करते तेव्हां ती खोटी असते व तीला विकल्प म्हणतात. या द्वैताचा घोटाळा मनच करते.
owis.englishMeaning: "This sankalpa is from brahman and therefore it is the Truth and the vikalpa is from maya and so it is not true". Such statements are simply the useless chatterings of duality. (sankalpa means the `I am' inspiration and vikalpa means opposing thoughts. Thus to say that `I am' and brahman are the same is misunderstanding. `I am' is maya and brahman is, I do not exist).

owis.original: जाणे ब्रह्म जाणे माया । ते येक जाणावी तुर्या । सर्व जाणे म्हणोनिया । सर्वसाक्षिणी ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्माचेहि ज्ञान व मायेचेहि ज्ञान हें तुर्या अवस्थें असते. दोन्हींही जाणते म्हणुन तीला सर्वसाक्षिणी म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is the knowing of brahman then, this is truly the knowing of maya and that One Reality should then be known as the turya state (in truth, brahman can not be know and to think you know Him is maya). It is the knowing of this `all' and therefore it is the witnessing of this `all'.

owis.original: ऐक तुर्येचें लक्षण । जेथें सर्व जाणपण । सर्वचि नाहीं कवण । जाणेल गा ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जी सर्व कांहीं जाणते ती तुर्या अवस्था होय. हें लक्षांत ठेवावे. परंतु सर्वच जेथें नाहींसे झाले तेथे जाणावयास काय उरले?
owis.englishMeaning: Listen and there will be this attention of turya. It is knowingness and it is this `all' `here'. And when even this `all' is not then, tell me, what will be known? (ie. no-knowledge or beyond knowledge)

owis.original: संकल्पविकल्पाची सृष्टी । जाली मनाचिये पोटीं । तें मनचि मिथ्या सेवटीं । साक्षी कवणु ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या मनांतून संकल्पविकल्पामुळें सृष्टी निर्माण झाली. तें मनच शेवटीं खोटे ठरल्यावर साक्षीपणानें पाहायला कोणीच उरत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The gross creations have arisen in the womb/cavity of the mind on account of this sankalpa and vikalpa (on account of knowledge and ignorance ie. *rajo guna there is the mind of the individual and in each mind a world of names and forms is born or imagined). But in the end when that mind is made false and there is that Reality then, how can there be a witness? *(You know something but you don't know what it is ie. knowledge and ignorance; then you give it a name and this is rajo guna)

owis.original: साक्षत्व चैतन्यत्व सत्ता । हे गुण ब्रह्माचिया माथां । आरोपलें जाण वृथा । मायागुणें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृशाचा कोणताच गुण शुद्ध ब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं नाहीं. साक्षित्व, चैतन्य व सत्ता हे गुण माया उगाचच ब्रह्माच्या माथीं मारते. ब्रह्मावर माया या गुणांचा आरोप करते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is witnessing then, there is this power of chaitanya and this guna of knowing gets placed upon the thoughtless head of brahman. But know that it is this pure sattwa guna of maya that is being vainly assigned as the thoughtless Self (see 7.3; that inexpressible and thoughtless brahman cannot be compared to these qualities of sagun brahman)

owis.original: घटमठाचेनि गुणें । त्रिविधा आकाश बोलणें । मायेचेनि खरेंपणें । गुण ब्रह्मीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाश खरें ऐकच आहे. पण घटाकाश म्हणजे भांड्यांतील आकाश, मठाकाश म्हणजे घरांतील आकाश व महद्आकाश म्हणजे विश्र्वांतील आकाश असे तीन भेद करतात. त्याचप्रमाणें माया खरी मानली म्हणजे ब्रह्मावर गुणांचा आरोप करतात. शुद्ध ब्रह्मांत हे गुण नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: The space in the pot, the space in the temple and the space outside the temple are due to this pure sattwa guna. When these three forms are the one space then there is this `speech'. It is this pure sattwa guna within brahman that gives trueness to maya. (The imperceptible brahman is true and this Truth gets superimposed upon the perceptible known. Still though it is felt to be true, in Oneness a feeling cannot be the Truth)

owis.original: जव खरेंपण मायेसी । तवचि साक्षत्व ब्रह्मासी । मायेअविद्येचे निरासीं । द्वैत कैचें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जोपर्यंत मायेचे खरेंपण वाटते, तोपर्यंत ब्रह्माला साक्षित्व असते. " मी साक्षीपणानें पहातों " असें द्वैत असते. पण माया व अविद्या या दोन्हीचें निरसन झालें म्हणजे मग द्वैत संपते  व त्याबरोबर साक्षित्व ही विलीन होते.
owis.englishMeaning: As long as there is the trueness of maya, then witnessing gets assigned to brahman. But when there is the discarding of avidya and maya then, where is duality (ie. when both "I am a body" and `I am' are not then, how can there be witnessing)?

owis.original: म्हणोनि सर्वसाक्षी मन । तेंचि जालिया उन्मन । मग तुर्यातरुप ज्ञान । मावळोन गेलें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनच व्यापक होता होता सर्वसाक्षी बनतें. तें जेव्हां उन्मन होते तेव्हां तुर्या अवस्था संपते. व त्याबरोबर मी सर्व जाणतो हें ज्ञान देखील मावळून जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the witnessing of the `all' is mind and when this becomes no-mind/un- mana then, this turya-form knowledge disappears.

owis.original: जयास द्वैत भासलें । तें मन उन्मन जालें । द्वैताअद्वैताचें तुटलें । अनुसंधान ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या मनाला द्वैताचा अनुभव येतो, तेंच मन उन्मन झालें कीं द्वैत नाहीसें होऊन अद्वैत उरते. मग द्वैत व अद्वैताचे चिंतन देखील आपोआप थांबते.
owis.englishMeaning: Duality appears to mula maya but when this mind becomes unmana or no- mind then, that breaks this attention of duality/non-duality (prakruti/purush or maya/brahman).

owis.original: येवं द्वैत आणी अद्वैत । होये वृत्तीचा संकेत । वृत्ती जालिया निवृत्त । द्वैत कैंचें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: द्वैत व अद्वैत हा भेद प्रतीत होणें हीं वृत्तीची खूण आहे. ही वृत्तीच नाहीशीं झाल्यावर मग द्वैत उरत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Thus when there is duality (maya) and non-duality (brahman) *together then, there is the knowing vritti. But when this vritti becomes nivritti then, how can there be duality? (Non-duality is always there but it has been hidden or concealed behind duality)

owis.original: वृत्तीरहित जें ज्ञान । तेंचि पूर्ण समाधान । जेथें तुटे अनुसंधान । मायाब्रह्मीचें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ज्ञानामध्यें वृत्तील जागाच नाहीं, तेंच खरें ब्रह्मज्ञान होय. तेथेंच पूर्ण समाधान होते. मग या ज्ञानामुळेंच माया व ब्रह्म यांचे चिंतन संपते.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya is without the knowing vritti then, there is that pure knowledge. Then it is whole and perfect and there is complete contentment/samadhan. Then the attention `here' of the maya within brahman is broken.

owis.original: मायाब्रह्म ऐसा हेत । मनेंत्त कल्पिला संकेत । ब्रह्म कल्पनेरहित । जाणती ज्ञानी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्य मायामय व शुद्ध ब्रह्म शाश्वत अशी कल्पना करुन मन खुणेंने दोन्हींचे अस्तित्व मानते. पण ब्रह्म कल्पनेरहित आहे हे ज्ञानी जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: maya/brahman (duality/non-duality), such is the original intent. It the imagining of this `I am' by the mind. But brahman is without imagination and is known only by the gnyani.

owis.original: जें मनबुद्धि अगोचर । जें कल्पनेंहून पर । तें अनुभवितां साचार । द्वैत कैंचें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शुद्ध ब्रह्म हें मन व बुद्धीयांच्या आटोक्याबाहेर आहे. ते कल्पनेपलिकडे आहे. त्या ब्रह्माचा साक्षात अनुभव घेतला म्ग द्वैत कुठलें. द्वैत पाहातां ब्रह्म नसे
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya is beyond the perception of mind and intellect then, mula maya is beyond imagination and you are the true `experiencer' and there is no duality (ie. you have found your Self).

owis.original: । ब्रह्म पाहातां द्वैत नासे । द्वैताद्वैत भासे । कल्पनेसी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: द्वैताचे भान असेपर्यंत ब्रह्माचा अनुभव येत नाही. आणि ब्रह्माचा अनुभव आला कीं, द्वैत उरत नाही. द्वैत व अद्वैत या कल्पना आहेत त्यांचा मनाला भास होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If duality is understood then, brahman disappears and if brahman is understood then, duality disappears. For it is due to imagination that there has appeared this duality/non-duality.

owis.original: कल्पना माया निवारी । कल्पना ब्रह्म थावरी । संशय धरी आणी वारी । तेहि कल्पना ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पना मायेचे निवारण करते. कल्पनाच ब्रह्माची स्थापना करते. कल्पनाच संशय निर्माण करते व कल्पनाच तो संशय नाहींसा करते.
owis.englishMeaning: It is imagination to think that maya has been knocked down and it is imagination to think that brahman has been built up (ie. it is imagination that thinks you have realised). Then there is the one who holds this `I am' doubt and the one who lets it go and that Reality is imagination.

owis.original: कल्पना करी बंधन । कल्पना दे समाधान । ब्रह्मीं लावी अनुसंधान । तेहि कल्पना ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पना बंधन निर्माण करते. कल्पना समाधान देते. कल्पनाच शुद्ध ब्रह्माचें चिंतनाची शिकवण देते.
owis.englishMeaning: Imagination binds and imagination brings samadhan. When one's attention is placed within brahman then, that Reality has become an imagination (and though you are the One brahman, you start to imagine something other).

owis.original: कल्पना द्वैताची माता । कल्पना ज्ञेप्ती तत्वता । बद्धता आणी मुक्तता । कल्पनागुणें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पना द्वैत निर्माण करते. खरोखर पाहीलें तर कल्पनाच ज्ञान आहे. मी बद्ध आहे व मी मुक्त आहे या अवस्था
owis.englishMeaning: Imagination is the mother of duality. Truly, imagination is this `knowing'. To be bound and to be free are due to this imagined sattwa guna.

owis.original: कल्पना अंतरी सबळ । नस्ते दावी ब्रह्मगोळ । क्षणभर येकातें निर्मळ । स्वरुप कल्पी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अंतर्यामी वास करणारी कल्पना जर सबळ असेल, जर ती देहबुद्धीला व अविद्येला धरुन असेल तर मुळांत नसलेले विश्र्व अनुभवास येते. तीच कल्पना एकांतात बसून निर्मळ केली तर दृश्य विरहित निर्मळ स्वरुप अनुभवास आणून देते.
owis.englishMeaning: When this imagination within this inner space of `I am' becomes impure then, it shows a non-existent brahmanda (ie. the universe and an individual body/pinda are all imagined within this `all' of `I am'). And when this inner space is made pure then, that swarup is imagined. (An impure imagination makes this `all' appear as the world we see through our senses and a pure imagination takes this `all' from thought to samadhan/thoughtlessness; see 7.3.49-51)

owis.original: क्षणा येका धोका वाहे । क्षणा येका स्थिर राहे । क्षणा येका पाहे । विस्मित होउनी ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पना संकटाची आठवण करुन काळजी उत्पन्न करील तर लगेच तें विसरुन मन स्थिर करील व पुढच्याच क्षणीं आश्र्चर्य करुं लागेल.
owis.englishMeaning: It is this `moment of the One' (the `now'/inner space) that meets dangers; it is this `moment of the One' that remains still; it is this `moment of the One' that understands and gets astonished. (All this is imagined in this inner space ie. maya)

owis.original: क्षणा येकातें उमजे । क्षणा येकातें निर्बुजे । नाना विकार करिजे । ते कल्पना जाणावी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या क्षणीं कल्पनेला सर्व स्वच्छ ज्ञान असते. पण दुसर्‍या क्षणीं त्याच्या उलट अज्ञान दाखवते. अशारीतीनें वृत्तीचे नाना प्रकार उत्पन्न करते ती कल्पना जाणावी.
owis.englishMeaning: To this `moment of the One' there comes the understanding of nirgun and to this `moment of the One' there comes great confusion. Then the `many' modifications are created and that Reality gets called your imagination (therefore understand this `mo- ment of the One' that brings nirgun and sagun; understand witnessing).

owis.original: कल्पना जन्माचें मूळ । कल्पना भक्तीचें फळ । कल्पना तेचि केवळ । मोक्षदाती ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही कल्पना आपल्या जन्माचे मूळ कारण आहे. भक्तीचें फळ देणारी कल्पनाच. आणि शेवटी मोक्ष देणारीही कल्पनाच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The root of birth is this imagination and the fruit of devotion is this imagination also (ie. a pure imagination); and it is imagination to think that, that Reality has become pure knowledge and the giver of freedom (Reality knows nothing of bondage and liberation, knowledge and pure knowledge etc.).

owis.original: असो ऐसी हे कल्पना । साधनें दे समाधाना । येरवी हे पतना । मूळच कीं ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो अशी ही कल्पना परमार्थ साधनेंत अडकविली तर समाधान देते. तसें केलें नाहीं तर माणसाचें अधःपतन करते.
owis.englishMeaning: So be it. But if you try to imagine that thoughtless Self then, this is the sadhana that will bring complete contentment/samadhan. Otherwise that thoughtless Self at the root becomes a fallen jiva?

owis.original: म्हणौन सर्वाचें मूळ । ते हे कल्पनाच केवळ । इचें केलियां निर्मूळ । ब्रह्मप्राप्ती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून या विश्वरचनेंचे मूळ असलेली कल्पना मूळासकट उपटून टाकीली तर ब्रह्मप्राप्तीला वेळ लागत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The root of this `all' is when that thoughtless pure knowledge starts to imagine. But if this imagination is uprooted then, that brahman will be attained.

owis.original: श्रवण आणी मनन । निजध्यासें समाधान । मिथ्या कल्पनेचें भान । उडोन जाये ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रवण, मनन व निदिध्यास या साधनामार्गानें गेलें असतां आत्मसाक्षात्कार होऊन खात्रीनें समाधान लाभतें. या साधनेनें दृश्यांत अडकलेल्या खोट्या कल्पनेचे भान साफ उडून जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is shravan and then manana (ie. remaining constantly in shravan/`I am') then, due to nididhyas (I am not) there is samadhan (I was ever free) and the awareness of false thoughts fly away.

owis.original: शुद्ध ब्रह्माचा निश्र्चयो । करी कल्पनेचा जयो । निश्र्चितार्थें संशयो । तुटोन गेला ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शुद्ध ब्रह्मस्वरुपाचा अनुभव येऊन प्रज्ञा स्थिर झाली कीं, कल्पना नाहीशीं होते. ब्रह्मज्ञानानेम मनामध्ये स्वस्वरुपाचा निश्र्चय झाला कीं, देहबुद्धीचें सर्व संशय नष्ट होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the conviction of that One pure brahman then, there is victory over the false imagination. And by the establishment of brahman this original doubt `I am' is broken and destroyed.

owis.original: मिथ्या कल्पनेचें कोडें । कैसें राहे साचापुढें । जैसें सूर्याचेनि उजेडें । नासे तम ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्याच्या प्रकाशापुढें अंधार टिकत नाही. त्याच प्रमाणेम खर्‍या शुद्ध ब्रह्मस्वरुपापुढें खोट्या कल्पनेचे कोडे टिकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as the darkness is destroyed by the rising of the sun, how can the false longings of imagination remain before the Truth?

owis.original: तैसें ज्ञानाचेनि प्रकाशें । मिथ्या कल्पना हे नासे । मग हें तुटे अपैसें । द्वैतानुसंधान ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मज्ञानच्या प्रकाशानें खोटी कल्पना नाश पावतें. मग द्वैताचे भान व चिंतन आपोआप नाहींसे होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then due to the light of pure knowledge, the false imagination gets destroyed and there is that thoughtless Self. That thoughtlessness automatically cuts this attention of duality.

owis.original: कल्पनेनें कल्पना उडे । जैसा मृगें मृग सांपडे । कां शरें शर आतुडे । आकाशमार्गीं ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याप्रमाणें हरणाचा उपयोग करुन हरीण पकडावे, बाणानेंच आकाशमार्गे येणारा बाण तोडावा, तसेच कल्पनेनेंच कल्पना नाहींशी करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Imagination can be nullified by imagination, just as a deer is used to catch a another deer or as an arrow is used to cut down another arrow that is flying through the space.

owis.original: शुद्ध कल्पनेचें बळ । जालियां नासे सबळ । हेंचि वचन प्रांजळ । सावध ऐका ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पना शुद्ध केली तर तीच्या अंगी मोठें सामर्थ्य निर्माण होते. त्यानें शबल किंवा अशुद्ध कल्पना नाहींशी करता येते. हे अधिक स्पष्ट सांगतो. ते ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the power of pure imagination, the impure imagination is removed (when you try to imagine that nirvikalpa/no thought, that cannot truly be imagined then `I am' is imagined and the `many' thoughts fly away). Then that clear and thoughtless Self is appearing as this divine `word'. Therefore listen further.

owis.original: शुद्ध कल्पनेची खूण । स्वयें कल्पिजे निर्गुण । सस्वरुपीं विस्मरण । पडोंचि नेदी ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पना शुद्ध असण्याची खूण म्हणजे ती स्वतः निर्गुणरुपांत स्थिर असते. स्वस्वरुपाचे विस्मरण ती कधीही होऊ देत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Pure imagination is the imagining of that natural nirgun Self and therefore in your true swarup, this forgetting should not be allowed to stop (this forgetting is remembe- ring yourself and remembering is forgetting of yourself and seeing a world).

owis.original: सदा स्वरुपानुसंधान । करी द्वैताचे निर्शन । अद्वयनिश्र्चयाचें ज्ञान । तेचि शुद्ध कल्पना ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सदैव स्वस्वरुपीं लीन, द्वैत दृश्याचे संपूर्ण विस्मरण, आणि अद्वितीय ब्रह्माचें साक्षात् ज्ञान या तीन गोष्टीं जेथें आढळतात,  तेथें शुद्ध कल्पना आहे असें खात्रीनें समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: For then your attention is always fix within your swarup and there will be the dissolution of duality. Understand that when there is this knowledge and the conviction of non-duality then, it is that Reality that is appearing as this pure imagination (still you are that Reality imagining).

owis.original: अद्वैत कल्पी ते शुद्ध । द्वैत कल्पी ते अशुद्ध । अशुद्ध तेचि प्रसिद्ध । सबळ जाणावी ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जी कल्पना अद्वैतांतच रममाण होते, ती शुद्ध व जी कल्पना द्वैतांतच रमते ती अशुद्ध होय. अशुद्ध कल्पनेला शबल कल्पना म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Thus when non-duality is imagined then, there is that Reality and this pure imagi- nation and when duality is imagined, then there is that Reality and an impure imagi- nation. And this impure imagination, you should known, is that Reality appearing as the impure thoughts (that Reality becomes whatever you imagine It to be; wherever you place It, there It will stay; It will not argue with you. Therefore how can that Reality be understood when you are letting It appear as impure thoughts?)

owis.original: शुद्ध कल्पनेचा अर्थ । अद्वैताचा निश्र्चितार्थ । आणी सबळ वेर्थ । द्वैत कल्पी ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकच एक ब्रह्म सत्य आहे असा निश्र्चय होणें हा शुद्ध कल्पनेचा अर्थ आहे. अशुद्ध कल्पना मात्र द्वैताची कल्पना करीत राहाते.
owis.englishMeaning: The essence of pure imagination is the conviction of non-duality (ie. I do not exist) and when there is impure imagination then, there are the worthless imaginings of du- ality.

owis.original: अद्वैतकल्पना प्रकाशे । तेचि क्षणीं द्वैत नासे । द्वैतासरिसी निरसे । सबळ कल्पना ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अद्वैत कल्पनेचा प्रकाश पडला की त्याच क्षणीं द्वैताचा नाश होतो. आणि द्वैताबरोबरच शबल (अशद्ध) कल्पना पण नाहीशी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the pure imagination of non-duality shines then, that Reality in that moment destroys duality and along with this duality, the impure imagination is destroyed.

owis.original: कल्पनेनें कल्पना सरे । ऐसी जाणावी चतुरें । सबळ गेलियां नंतरें । शुद्ध उरली ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शुद्ध कल्पनेने अशुद्ध कल्पना नाहीशीं करता येते हें चतुर लोकांनी समजुन घ्यावें. एकदा अशुद्ध कल्पना गेली कीं शुद्ध कल्पनाच उरते.
owis.englishMeaning: By imagination, imagination can be wiped out; such should be known by the wise. When the impure has gone then after, only the pure remains.

owis.original: शुद्ध कल्पनेचे रुप । तेंचि जें कल्पी स्वरुप । स्वरुप कल्पितां तद्रूप । होये आपण ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शुद्ध कल्पना ज्याची कल्पना करतें तेच आपले स्वस्वरुप होय. त्या स्वरुपाची कल्पना करुं लागले की आपण तद्रुपच होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when the pure is imagined as a form/rup then, that Reality appears as mula maya and this is imagined to be that swa-rup. Still if you imagine your swarup then, you will become That only (this is all the subtle play of duality/non-duality ie. prakruti and purush. It is the difference between taking this knowledge as true or `seeing' this knowledge as nothing but a dream appearing upon you. It is the difference between being the known and being the Knower. First the known should be established but still know, this is the impure imagining of duality. By a pure imagination you separate yourself from the known and become the detached thoughtless Knower. This is the sadhana of the sadhak)

owis.original: कल्पनेसी मिथ्यत्व आलें । सहजचि तद्रूप जालें । आत्मनिश्र्चयें नासिलें । कल्पनेसी ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वस्वरुपाशीं तद्रुप झाले म्हणजे आत्मसाक्षात्कार होतो. आत्मस्वरुपाखेरीज इतर कांहीं सत्य नाहीं असा निश्र्चय झाला म्हणजे कल्पना नाहींशी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: However if the illusory is imagined then, that natural swarup becomes like the illusory. Still such imagination gets destroyed by that conviction of that atma (I am that thoughtless witnessing atma. I cannot be anything that is known or perceived).

owis.original: जेचि क्षणीं निश्र्चये चळे । तेचि क्षणीं द्वैत उफळे । जैसा अस्तमानीं प्रबळे । अंधकार ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याक्षणीं तद्रुपतेला धक्का बसून आत्मनिश्र्चय डळमळतो, त्याच क्षणीं द्वैतमय दृश्य उफाळून वर येते. ज्याप्रमाणें सूर्य अस्ताला जाऊं लागला जोरानें पसरुं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when this conviction gets disturbed then, at that moment, that Reality arises as mula maya (ie. known), just as darkness abounds when the sun sets.

owis.original: तैसें ज्ञान होतां मळिण । अज्ञान प्रबळे जाण । याकारणें श्रवण । अखंड असावें ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणे आत्मज्ञान मलिन झालें कीं अज्ञानाचा जोर वाढतो. हें टाळण्यासाठीं अखंडपणें श्रवण करीत जावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When knowledge gets polluted in this way, then know that ignorance prevails and it grows very powerful (and then a gross body is imagined). Therefore by means of this shravan there should be that unbroken Self (first forget everything and be this `I am' and then understand, I do not exist).

owis.original: आतां असो हें बोलणें जालें । आशंका फेडू येका बोले । जयास द्वैत भसलें । तें तूं नव्हेसी सर्वथा ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां हें बोलणें पुरे झाले. यानंतर एकाच वाक्यानें शंका निरसन करुं. ज्या कल्पनारुप मनाला हें द्वैतमय दृश्य अनुभवास येतें तें मन तुझें खरें स्वरुप मुळींच नाही. खरा तूं त्या पलीकडे आहेस.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, when that thoughtless Self appears as this `speech' then, there is doubt and fear. For that One is hidden and there is this `I am'. And when this duality of mula maya appears then, you are absolutely not that Reality.

owis.original: मागील आशंका फिटली । इतुकेन हे कथा संपली । पुढें वृत्ति सावध केली । पाहिजे श्रोतीं ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील शंका निरसन झाली. म्हणून हा चालू विषय संपला. पुढील विषय ऐकण्यासाठीं श्रोत्यांनी मनाची एकाग्रता करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously this doubt `I am' had been removed and due to this, this `story' of God ended and there was that thoughtless swarup. Therefore, again the true listener should be very alert ahead and be this knowing vritti. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Baddha Mukta Nirupan (A Discourse on the Bound and the Liberated)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: अद्वैत ब्रह्म निरोपिलें । जें कल्पनेरहित संचलें । क्षणयेक तदाकार केलें । मज या निरुपणें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोता म्हणाला कीं, जेथें कल्पनेस वाव नाहीं असें सर्व ठिकाणीं सांठलेले अद्वैत ब्रह्म आपण वर्णन केले. तें वर्णन ऐकून एकक्षणभर मी त्या ब्रह्माशी तदाकार होऊन गेलो.
owis.englishMeaning: "There was that discourse of the non-dual brahman when mula maya stopped ima- gining. Thus on account of this `I am', there was that *`Dweller in brahman'." *(See 7.3; `The One who dwells in brahman' is the thirteenth brahman ie. no-otherness or non-duality. Then there is the fourteenth brahman and that is Final Liberation; then one is forever free. Still understand that such liberation will only be gained if one first understands this `I am' of mula maya)

owis.original: परी म्यां तदाकार व्हावें । ब्रह्मचि होऊन असावें । पुन्हा संसारास न यावें । चंचळपणें सर्वथा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां असें वाटते कीं, त्या ब्रह्माशी तदाकार होऊन राहावें. वृत्ती चंचल होऊन परत संसारांत पडू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: "This `I' should `Dwell in brahman'; this `I' should be brahman and not come again back into this samsar that has appeared on account of the *moving `all'." *(When you wake up first, there is this aum, `I am' feeling or sagun brahman; at that time the world is perceived as one moving form. Then afterwards `many' thoughts come, "I must do this and meet him and go there etc.etc." and you, who are knowledge, imagines that you are a body)

owis.original: कल्पनारहित जें सुख । तेथें नाहीं संसारदुःख । म्हणोनि तेंचि येक । होऊन असावें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पनारहित झाल्यावर तेथें सुख मिळते व तेथें संसारांतील दुःखेंही नाहीत. म्हणून तेंच एक ( ब्रह्म ) होऊन असावेंसे वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: "When mula maya is freed of all imagination then, there is the pleasure of brahman and `there' is not the pain of samsar. Therefore, that One who only is, should always be." (There is but One without a second; the rest is imagined)

owis.original: ब्रह्मचि होईजे श्रवणें । पुन्हा वृत्तीवरी लागे येणें । ऐसें सदा येणें जाणें । चुकेना कीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परंतु प्रत्यक्षांत असें घडते कीं श्रवणाने मन ब्रह्माकार होते. पण तेंच मन परत देहबुद्धिच्या वृत्तीवर येते. हे असे येणेजाणे कांहीं चुकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: "Due to shravan there is brahman (ie. nivritti) but then, once more there is the touching of this knowing vritti. In this way, that eternal Self comes and goes.7 Please tell me, why can I not give up this wavering condition?" (Why has steadfast conviction 7nisargadatta maharaj- The Unmanifest ever exists but this manifest knowingness arises and departs or perfect understanding not been established?)

owis.original: मनें अंतरिक्ष जावें । क्षणयेक ब्रह्मचि व्हावें । पुन्हा तेथून कोंसळावें । वृत्तीवरी मागुतें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मन क्षणभर अंतराकाशांत विहार करतअसते परंतु परत तेंच मन वृत्तीवर कोसळते.
owis.englishMeaning: "The mind goes in this space where there is this `I am' (ie. the ever-present `now') and then it becomes brahman (ie. beyond this time of the `I am' or `now'). But again from `there' it tumbles down and falls back onto this knowing vritti (and space)."

owis.original: प्रत्यावृत्ती सैरावैरा । किती करुं येरझारा । पांई लाउनियां दोरा । कीटक जैसा ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा वर जाणें व खाली येणें अशा येरझारा फार झाल्या. किटकला पायाला दोरा बांधून वरखाली फिरवावा तशी माझी अवस्था झाली आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: "And then afterwards there is this running back and forward, helter-skelter, in the wearisome and empty `many'. Really I am just like a small butterfly that has been tied to a fine thread and though I am allowed to fly, I once again get pulled back by a whim." (My desires pull me back)

owis.original: उपदेशकाळीं तदाकार । होतां पडे हें शरीर । अथवा नेणे आपपर । ऐसें जालें पाहिजे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला उपदेश ऐकतांना मन ब्रह्माकार होतें. त्याच अवस्थेंत हा देह पडला पाहीजे. तसे होणार नसेल तर माझे तुझे हा भेदच मनांतून नाहींसा व्हावा.
owis.englishMeaning: "Either that `Dweller in brahman' should be in this `I am' where a separation still remains and that thoughtless swarup is this `I am' body or, no separation between this `I am' body and the `Dweller in brahman' should be known." (Either I should be this `I am'/knowledge or this knowledge should be submerged in pure knowledge. These are the two forms of liberation mentioned ahead. But I should, on no account, enter samsar again)

owis.original: ऐसें नस्तां जें बोलणें । तेंचि वाटे लाजिरवाणें । ब्रह्म होऊन संसार करणें । हेंहि विपरीत दिसे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी अवस्था जोपर्यंत येत नाही, तोपर्यंत ब्रह्मज्ञानाच्या गोष्टी बोलण्याची लाज वाटते. ब्रह्मस्वरुप झाल्यावर पुन्हा संसार करणें हेही विपरीत दिसते.
owis.englishMeaning: "But when this `speech' of `I am' is not then, there is the feeling of shame (ie. `I am' has no feeling of shame. It has the feeling of bliss and `I am true'. It is body consciousness and samsar that brings shame and `many' emotions). Then though being brahman, one makes samsar and that thoughtless Self appears as something quite different."

owis.original: जो स्वयें ब्रह्मचि जाला । तो मागुता कैसा आला । ऐसें ज्ञान माझें मजला । प्रशस्त न वटे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो स्वतः ब्रह्मरुप होतो. तो पुन्हा देहबुद्धींत माघारीं कसा येतो? ब्रह्मज्ञान झालेला परत देहबुद्धींत येत असेल तर त्याचें तें ज्ञान पक्के नाही, असे मला वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: "When that purush has naturally become brahman then, why does He once again come back into samsar? Like this is my knowledge and it does not feel like I have properly understood." (How can true knowledge be changing?)

owis.original: ब्रह्मचि होऊन जावें । कां तें संसारींच असावें । दोहींकडे भरंगळावें । किती म्हणूनी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक ब्रह्मस्वरुप तरी होऊन जावें किंवा एक संसारांत असावें. दोन्हीकडची येरझारा आतां पुरें.
owis.englishMeaning: "Surely one should be brahman. Why should that Reality become a samsari? The- refore the `many' wanderings of the restless mind should be placed in the charge of this `I am' of prakruti/purush."

owis.original: निरुपणीं ज्ञान प्रबळे । उठोन जातां तें मावळे । मागुता कामक्रोध खवळे । ब्रह्मरुपासी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्नाचे निरुपण चालूं असतां ज्ञान होते. परंतु निरुपण संपल्यावर तेथून उठलें कीं तें ज्ञान नाहींसे होते. थोड्यावेळापूर्वीं ब्रह्मरुप झालेला आतां परत खवळलेल्या कामक्रोधांत बुडुन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: "During this *discourse, knowledge overflowed but then, that Reality got up and left and again passions and anger sweep over this `all'." *(You had forgotten everything and everything was in your knowledge. But then you start imagining and, out of nothing, an individual and a world of `many' names and forms appear)

owis.original: ऐसा कैसा ब्रह्म जाला । दोहींकडे अंतरला । वोडगस्तपणेंचि गेला । संसार त्याचा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग असें वाटतें कीं, हे असे कसलें ब्रह्मरुप होणें ? अखेर ज्ञान मावळल्यावर ब्रह्म हातचें जाते व परमार्थाच्या नावावर संसार पण हातचा जातो. मनुष्य दोन्हींला मुकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: "When this is the case then, how can that brahman ever be realized? And though being always in the company of this prakruti/purush, it is disregarded and there is samsar and that brings only distress."

owis.original: घेतां ब्रह्मसुखाची गोडी । संसारिक मागें वोडी । संसार करितां आवडी । ब्रह्मीं उपजे मागुती ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मसुखाची गोडी घेण्याचा प्रयत्न करुंलागल्यास संसारसुख माघारीं खेचतें, संसारंत मन गुतवलें तर ब्रह्मसुखाची गोडी मनाला परत आपल्याकडे खेचते.
owis.englishMeaning: "When there is a fondness for the pleasure of brahman then, samsar pulls me back and when there is the likings of samsar then, I again remember that this is all appearing in brahman." (On account of worldly desires the pleasure of thoughtlessness is spoiled. But when you come to realize that these pleasures that the worldly desires bring are just like the objects themslves ie. they are imagined then, their lustre and pleasure no longer entralls you and this world loses its thrill. Thus like the small butterfly, you cannot be free)

owis.original: ब्रह्मसुख नेलें संसारें । संसार गेला ज्ञानद्वारें । दोनी अपुरीं पुरें । येकहि नाहीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संसाराच्या ओढीनें ब्रह्मसुख हातचे जातें तर ब्रह्मज्ञानाच्या जोरानें संसार हातचा जातो. दोन्ही अर्धवट राहतात. एकही पुरें होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: "Thus due to samsar, the pleasure of brahman is stolen away. But if now, knowledge is understood then that samsar will be destroyed. Still if such knowledge is of this incomplete prakruti then, that complete One is not realized." (For it is only when this prakruti is no longer desired that the purush is directly realized and you know your own Self. Then there is the One without a second)

owis.original: याकारणें माझें चित्त । चंचळ जालें दुश्र्चीत । काये करणे निश्र्चीत । येकहि नाहीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोता म्हणतो कीं, अशा परिस्थितींत सापडल्यानें माझें मन अस्वस्थ होऊन मी गोंधळून गेलो आहे. ब्रह्मज्ञान साध्य करावें कां सरळ संसार करावा, काय करावें, दोन्हीपैकी एकच करण्याचा मनाचा निश्र्चय होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: "Then my mind is this `speech' and there is this moving `all' but still this is the forgetting of my true Self. Then how can that One who has been forgotten, ever be determined?"

owis.original: ऐसा श्रोता करी विनती । आतां राहावें कोणे रीतीं । म्हणे अखंड माझी मती । ब्रह्माकार नाहीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग श्रोत्यानें विनंती केलीं कीं, मी आतां कोणत्या रीतीनें जीवन घालवावें? माझें मन कांहीं अखंड ब्रह्माकार होऊन राहू शकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Thus the listener besceehed the speaker, "Now, how should I stay? For when there is this worldly talk of mine (ie. creating doubts and concepts) then, that unbroken swarup is merely a mental understanding and I am not `Dwelling in brahman'."

owis.original: आतां याचें प्रत्योत्तर । वक्ता देईल सुंदर । श्रोतीं व्हावें निरोत्तर । क्षण येक आतां ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां याचे उत्तर वक्ता सुंदर उत्तर देणार आहे. श्रोत्यांनी क्षणभर मन स्वस्थ करुन ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, the speaker will make His reply and bestow this beautiful pure sattwa guna upon the listener. Therefore now the listener should remain quiet in this `moment' (Now the speaker tells the listener to set aside these doubts and remain in this `all' understanding; then you will understand that both the speaker and listener are within you only).

owis.original: ब्रह्मचि होऊन जे पडिले । तेचि मुक्तपदास गेले । येर ते काय बुडाले । व्यासादिक ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्माशी तदाकार झाल्याबरोबर ज्यांनी देह ठेविला तेवढेंच मुक्त झाले, आणि व्यासादिक बाकीचे मुक्त झालेंच नाहींत कां?
owis.englishMeaning: The speaker said. Though you are brahman, this mula maya has appeared and that `place' of liberation has been lost (first you forgot your Self). But truly how can mula maya drown that Reality of such great Saints like vyasa? (Though you may feel you are lost still, that Reality has never lost its Self)

owis.original: श्रोता विनती करी पुढती । शुको मुक्तो वामदेवो वा हे श्रुती । दोघेचि मुक्त आदिअंतीं । बोलतसे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोता पुन्हा नम्रपणें विनंती करतो कीं, शुक व वामदेव हें मुक्त झालें असें वेदवचन आहे. आरंभापासून शेवटपर्यंत हे दोघेच मुक्त झाले असा या वाक्याचा अर्थ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener was confused and said, "Only shuka and vamdev were liberated, this is said so in the vedas. From beginning to end, they are the only two who are liberated."

owis.original: वेदें बद्ध केले सर्व । मुक्त शुक वामदेव । वेदवचनीं अभाव । कैसा धरावा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेदांच्या म्हणण्याप्रमाणें शुक व वामदेव हे दोघेच मुक्त झाले बाकीचे सर्व बद्धच समजावेत. वेदवचन चुकीचे मानता येणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: "The vedas have said that all others are in bondage and only shuka and vamdev are liberated. Why should one not keep faith in what the vedas say?"

owis.original: ऐसा श्रोता वेदाधारें । देता झाला प्रत्योत्तरें । दोघेचि मुक्त अत्यादरें । प्रतिपाद्य केले ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यानें वेदवचनाचा आधार घेऊन असें मोठ्या आदरानें दाखवून  दिलें कीं दोघेच मुक्त आहेत व बाकीचे सर्व बद्ध आहेत, असे प्रतिपादन केले.
owis.englishMeaning: Taking the support of the vedas, the listener replied in this way and then with the utmost respect he said, "Only these two are liberated."

owis.original: वक्ता बोले याउपरी । दोघेचि मुक्त सृष्टीवरी । ऐसें बोलतां उरी । कोणास आहे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वक्ता म्हणाला तुझ्या म्हणण्याप्रमाणें दोघेंच मुक्त आहेत, हें खरें मानलें तर मोठमोठ्या ज्ञानी पुरुषांना मुक्तांच्या वर्गांत जागाच उरणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The speaker continued to speak. He said that this statement of the vedas should be properly understood. It means that from this gross creation there are two kinds of liberations (ie. sagun and nirgun). For even if you make this sagun `speech' still someone remains (ie. the first liberation is `I am'. This still remains ie. shuka still remains. See V.45,46; the first liberation is jivan mukta and this is the sagun `I am' experience and the second liberation is videha mukta or the understanding, I do not exist)

owis.original: बहु ऋषि बहु मुनी । सिद्ध योगी आत्मज्ञानी । जाले पुरुष समाधानी । असंख्यात ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ ऋषी, मुनि, सिद्ध, योगी व आत्मज्ञानी आतांपर्यंत होऊन गेले, ते सगळे ब्रह्मज्ञानी होते. मुक्त होते. समाधानी होते. असे पुष्कळ होऊन गेले.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' in bondage and there are the rishis; there are the `many' in bondage and there are the munis. There are the siddhas, the yogis and the atma gnyanis and there is that purush, the one in samadhan and there is that immeasurable Reality. (There are the `many' in bondage but there were those who have been liberated, not just shuka and vamdev; and there is, was and always will be, those who have understood that forever free Reality) -

owis.original: याहि वेगळे थोर थोर । ब्रह्माविष्णुमहेश्र्वर । आदिकरुन दिगंबर । विदेहादिक ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, शंकर, दत्तात्रेय, विदेही जनक इत्यादि आणखी किती थोर थोर मुक्त ज्ञानी होऊन गेले.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this `speech' (ie. sagun) that is quite different from the greatest of the great (that Reality, like vyasa etc.) and there is brahma, vishnu and maheshwara (gunas and objectification). But as well as them, there is that one who is free of all coverings, pervading like the sky and that is the videha like janaka (ie. without body). (There are the mixed gunas of the `many' in bondage and there is this liberation known as the `I am'/knowledge/sagun and there is the videha/beyond knowledge/nirgun and there is the greatest of the great ie. vyasa etc. They are the Reality and That has nothing to do with all this).

owis.original: शुक वामदेव मुक्त जाले । येर ते अवघेचि बुडाले । या वचना विश्र्वासले । ते पढतमूर्ख ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शुक व वामदेव मुक्त झाले. बाकीचे मुक्त झाले नाहीत. या वचनावर जो विश्र्वास ठेवील तो पढतमूर्ख होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The first liberation of shuka and vamdev was still in the mind (ie. first liberation is the thought `I am') and therefore that thoughtless nirgun was drowned. And if one was to believe in this `speech' only then, that Reality has become a knowledgeable fool (this `speech' is a liberation; it is liberation from gross body consciousness. But it is not the understanding, I do not exist ie. liberation from the `I' and this is the second liberation or videha. Then in V. 35 we are told of a third liberation. This is Reality or Final Liberation. There, there was never the concept of bondage nor liberation and you were forever free. videha is that thoughtless Reality but there the possibility of falling once more into `I am' and then back into the `many' thoughts, still remains. However in that Final Liberation you have been completely dissolved and can never return; like the drop of salt in the ocean).

owis.original: तरी वेद कैसे बोलिला । तो काये तुम्हीं मिथ्या केला । ऐकोन वक्ता देता जाला । प्रत्योत्तर ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोता म्हणाला वेदांचे वचन तुम्ही खोटे मानणार कां? हे ऐकून वक्ता उत्तर देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener asked, "What is this `speech' of the vedas and how did you make this `speech' false?" Having listened, the speaker gave His reply.

owis.original: वेद बोलिला पूर्वपक्ष । मूर्ख तेथेंचि लावी लक्ष । साधु आणी वित्पन्न दक्ष । त्यांस हें न मने ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेदानें पूर्वपक्ष मांडला आहे. मूर्ख माणूस तेवढेंच खरें मानतो. साधु, विद्वान व चतुर माणसें तेवढेंच खरें मानत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: This `speech' of the vedas is the original hypothesis (or `I am He') and the foolish place their attention there only. But the sadhu and the clever speaker do not hinder that thoughtless videha (they dissolve this `I am' in thoughtlessness. It is this thought of `I' that keeps the thoughtless Self concealed. It is and was always there but thought cannot know it).

owis.original: तथापी हें जरी मानलें । तरी वेदसामर्थ्य बुडालें । वेदांचेनि उद्धरिलें । न वचे कोणा ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तरीसुद्धा हें खरें मानलें तर वेदांचे सामर्थ्य राहणार नाही. कारण मग वेदांच्या सामर्थ्यानें कोणाचाच उद्धार होणें शक्य होणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When thoughtlessness is valued then, this power of the `all' of the vedas is drowned. For the vedas cannot uplift this `all'. (The vedas can give this understanding of `I am' or the `all' but they cannot make you that thoughtless Self; only sadguru can bring about that Final Liberation)

owis.original: वेदा आंगीं सामर्थ्य नसे । तरी या वेदास कोण पुसे । म्हणौनि वेदीं सामर्थ्य असे । जन उधरावया ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेदांच्या अंगीं ब्रह्मज्ञान करुन देऊन जीवाला उद्धरण्याचें सामर्थ्य नसेल तर वेदांना कोणी विचारणार नाहीं. वस्तुस्थिती अशी नाही. म्हणून जीवाला मुक्त करण्याचे सामर्थ्य वेदांच्या अंगी आहे यांत शंका नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `I am' power (existence) of this `all' body (knowledge) is not, then this `speech' of the vedas will be wiped out by the `many' thoughts.
